Chapter 482: Chapter 18 Five Hundred Years (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 482: Chapter 18 Five Hundred Years (Seeking Subscriptions)

“`

“Power of the World?”

Open Heaven Immortal King, Supreme Immortal Kings such as the Supreme Immortal King exchanged glances; they had never heard of such Power of Creation before.

However, since Martial Ancestor said so, the power must exist.

“Let’s go.”

“Let’s take a look at the Eighth Layer of Heaven.”

...

After Lin Yuan finished speaking, he headed towards the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

At that time, the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven no longer had the Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era standing guard; it was empty, with wisps of illusory power drifting around.

That was the trial from the Seventh Layer of Heaven to the Eighth Layer of Heaven, a natural phenomenon within the Nine Heavens. Even if destroyed, it would recover.

Just like the barriers between the layers of heaven torn by Lin Yuan were now quickly restoring themselves.

“Just go straight up from the entrance.”

Lin Yuan took a glance.

Previously, when the Taiji Primordial Spirit was ambushed by the Lingxu Immortal King, Lin Yuan, in his true body, was in a rush, so he bulldozed his way through with a brute force approach; now, there was no need for that.

The entrance was right in front of them; they could simply pass through.

The trial from the Seventh Layer of Heaven to the Eighth Layer of Heaven, similar to a Soul Illusion, was not unlike the Heart Demon Tribulation and the Tribulation of the Spirit, but it was many times stronger than the latter.

However, the many Supreme Immortal Kings present had been tempered over a long period of time, and the strength of their spirits, even without deliberate cultivation, was not so weak that they could not easily pass through.

Although Lin Yuan had experienced a relatively short period of time, his Mental Will Index, having been honed in a Supreme Being’s body, coupled with the nurturing of his vast Inner World, was no weaker than that of the Supreme Immortal Kings present, if not stronger.

Whoosh…

Lin Yuan easily arrived at the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

The environment here was similar to the Seventh Layer of Heaven.

The only difference was that there was a mysterious aura faintly permeating the area, originating from the Ninth Layer of Heaven above.

There are people beyond man, and heavens beyond heavens; above the Nine Heavens are the Celestial Beings.

That’s the age-old saying in the Vast Spirit Realm regarding the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

The so-called Celestial Beings, as speculated by many Supreme Immortal Kings, might be an invincible entity seated in the Ninth Layer of Heaven overlooking the vast Spirit Realm.

The reason why the Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era and the many Eras of the Three Thousand Dao States were so eager to enter the Ninth Layer of Heaven was to seek the guidance of that invincible entity.

“This is the Eighth Layer of Heaven?”

“Indeed, it’s extraordinary, different from the Seventh Layer of Heaven.”

Open Heaven Immortal King and Supreme Immortal Kings like the Supreme Immortal King followed closely behind.

This was their first ascent to the Eighth Layer of Heaven; during past ascension battles, they were all repelled by the Lingxu Immortal King.

Now, following behind Lin Yuan, they finally realized their longstanding wish.

“The Ninth Layer of Heaven?”

Lin Yuan looked up, gazing into the sky.

Compared to the barriers of the previous eight layers of heaven, the barrier of the Ninth Layer of Heaven faintly emitted a pale golden light, and even Lin Yuan was not sure he could break through it.

Or to say, confident about shredding it, but it would take a significant amount of time, as the barrier between the Nine Heavens, once damaged, would quickly regenerate.

The speed at which Lin Yuan tore the barrier had to be much faster than the rate at which it recovered.

“Let’s go to the entrance of the Ninth Layer of Heaven.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind; after the Soul Search of the Lingxu Immortal King, he was very familiar with the Eighth Layer of Heaven and directly flew towards the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

…

The entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

Dozens of figures stood there.

These dozens of figures were the most powerful of the Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era, each having cultivated at least one type of high-level Power of Creation to the Third Realm.

Most had mastered more than two types of high-level Power of Creation in the Third Realm. The Lingxu Immortal King had so oppressed the Supreme Immortal Kings of the Three Thousand Dao States Era that they could hardly breathe.

But among this group of Supreme Immortal Kings, they were basically at the bottom of the ranks.

In the Prehistoric Era, having experienced a complete era of time, plus the long years of the current Three Thousand Dao States, the number of Supreme Immortal Kings was much larger and stronger than the immature Three Thousand Dao States Era.

Swoosh swoosh swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared not far away.

Open Heaven Immortal King and Supreme Immortal Kings like the Supreme Immortal King also followed behind Lin Yuan.

“So many powerful beings?”

Open Heaven Immortal King was a bit overwhelmed; only now did they realize how ludicrous their battles for ascension had been.

Among the many Supreme Immortal Kings standing at the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, just a few could easily suppress the twenty-some Supreme Immortal Kings.

Supreme Immortal King was also looking tense at this moment; had it not been for Lin Yuan standing in front of them, they might have had the urge to flee.

The head of the various Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era was a tall figure with a chaotic aura. He stood at the very forefront of all the Immortal Kings, clearly the leader among the Prehistoric Era’s strongest Immortal Kings.

“Chaotic Celestial King.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm.

Having Soul Searched Lingxu Immortal King, Lin Yuan naturally knew that the Chaotic Celestial King was the strongest Immortal King of the Prehistoric Era.

“Martial Ancestor.”

The Chaotic Celestial King turned around, looking seriously at Lin Yuan, “Lingxu has already told me.”

“Your strength, Martial Ancestor, far surpasses mine.”

“Whatever you want, Martial Ancestor, just say it, and I will agree.”

The Chaotic Celestial King spoke frankly as if yielding proactively was not a matter of shame.

In fact, that was indeed the case; Lingxu Immortal King had already shown to the Chaotic Celestial King and other Supreme Immortal Kings the happenings of the Seventh Layer of Heaven.

Including the Chaotic Celestial King, all the Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era acknowledged that they could not accomplish what Martial Ancestor had done.

Even in many deductions made by the Chaotic Celestial King, even if all Supreme Immortal Kings joined forces, in the face of Martial Ancestor, they could at best only struggle to survive for a while before inevitably facing defeat.

Knowing the outcome in advance, the Chaotic Celestial King naturally would not have any resistance, yielding and admitting defeat proactively.

“Oh?”
